iti16:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ.
iti16:2.1: sekhassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno appattamānasassa anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānassa viharato aṅganti karitvā na aññaṃ ekaṅgampi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ bahūpakāraṃ yathayidaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikāro.
iti16:2.2: yoniso bhikkhave bhikkhu manasikaronto akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāvetīti.
iti16:4.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
